name: Dark Basement
source:
Dark Basement is a visual novel game set in the horror genre. It's a short story, where the protagonist (you) finds himself in some kind of basement and tries to escape.

Originally intended for Asylum Jam 2013, but not finished in time.

[Edited from [url=http://gamejolt.com/games/adventure/dark-basement/19388/]Game Jolt[/url]]
translation:
《黑暗地下室》是一款恐怖类型的视觉小说游戏。这是一个短篇故事，主角（你）发现自己身处某种地下室并试图逃脱。

原本打算为2013年的Asylum Jam创作，但未能及时完成。

[编辑自[url=http://gamejolt.com/games/adventure/dark-basement/19388/]游戏震动[/url]]
